name: Elle:PrieR ~Shiawase no Kakera o Sagashite~
original_name: Elle:PrieR ～しあわせの欠片をさがして～
source:
Ryou lives in futuristic city of Oozora-shi and his normal life changes with the arrival of a girl named Konomi. She is an android created by his father who doesn’t have any memories. In order to regain her memories, she attends school and he brings her to many places, talks with her a lot and even does ecchi things occasionally. Who is Konomi and why does Ryou want her to regain her memories?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/08/01/august-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
Ryou住在未来城市大空市，他的正常生活随着一个名叫Konomi的女孩的到来而改变。她是父亲创造的机器人，没有任何记忆。为了恢复记忆，她去上学，他带她去了很多地方，和她聊了很多，甚至偶尔做一些ecchi的事情。Konomi是谁？为什么Ryou希望她恢复记忆？

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/08/01/august-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
